messages:
maya: Quick sync — building a small probe calibration + prompt bank for the upcoming INT8/GPTQ/AWQ bakeoff. Need guidance on composition and pass/fail thresholds. Who can weigh in? :eyes:
samir: I can. Key things: coverage across modalities, tail-lengths, instruction vs chat, and prefix caching artifacts. Keep it compact: ~2k samples but balanced.
olga: For quant evals I'd rather 1) stratify by task (QA, summarization, math, code, translation, dialog), 2) stratify by token length (<=32, 33-128, 129-512, >512), 3) edge-case buckets (truncated context, repetition, stop-seq). Each bucket get N samples.
jonathan: How big is N? We should define quotas per bucket and weighted sampling for rare failure modes.
samir: Proposal: total 1800 samples. Per-task: 300 each for 6 tasks. Within task split lengths: 40/30/20/10%. Edge buckets: 6x50 adversarial per task = 300 extra (included).
maya: ok add modality quotas for code: include compile/test snippets, and math with symbolic expressions. Also include non-English samples for translation bucket (~10%).
olga: We need a small held-out calibration set (200) used for quantization parameter tuning, and a separate eval probe (500) for accuracy checks. Calibration should be representative of the short-middle lengths.
jonathan: Suggested pass criteria: mean ROUGE/EM/CodeBLEU drop < 1.5% for INT8 baseline, max per-task delta < 3%. For AWQ we can be looser but require no catastrophic failures (>=95% syntactic validity).
samir: Also measure latencies: p50/p95 token latency on dedicated vs hosted profiles. Include batch sizes 1/4/16 to emulate low-latency vs throughput.
maya: Example sampling config (used by sampler service):
```
{
  "total":1800,
  "tasks":["qa","summ","math","code","trans","dialog"],
  "per_task":300,
  "length_bins":[{"<=32":0.4},{"33-128":0.3},{"129-512":0.2},{">512":0.1}],
  "edge_buckets":{"truncation":50,"repetition":50,"stop_seq":50}
}
```
olga: Don't forget prompt variants: instruction-only, few-shot, chain-of-thought, chain-of-thought with hidden steps. Include temperature 0 and 0.7 runs for sampling-sensitive evals.
jonathan: Also record input fingerprint (prompt template id, seed) + model config (quant backend, bits, group size). We'll need it for reproducibility.
eval-bot: run: bakeoff_probe_v3 started on 1765432100 — backfills calibration set, scheduling runs for INT8/GPTQ/AWQ.
maya: Great. For the calibration subset label them cal_short_200 and hold eval_probe_500 for final scoring. I'll push a candidate prompt bank to the repo by EOD. :thumbsup:
samir: I'll add a validation script to assert per-task sample counts and length distributions.
eval-bot: update: bakeoff_probe_v3 complete (3 models). Quick summary: INT8 mean delta 0.9%, GPTQ 1.8%, AWQ 2.6%. p95 latency differences: +12ms INT8, +9ms GPTQ, +18ms AWQ.
maya: Nice preliminary numbers. Let's sync tomorrow to decide which quant kernels to surface for Dedicated profiles. Thanks all.
